core.title: Butterfly Cabinet Hinge Pair, Acorn RJ1BQ

text.description_html:
Acorn RJ1BQ, Rough Iron Butterfly Cabinet Hinge

For interior cabinet doors. This hinge is a butterfly design. It is easy to install, and lends a traditional theme to a ranch or Colonial style home decor. It's an attractive full surface hinge of an unusual but authentic design. No mortising necessary. The rough iron finish duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals and imitates the natural weathering of iron.

Features of the Acorn RJ1BQ Butterfly Cabinet Hinges:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Height: 2-5/8"
  • Width: 2"

Sold as a Pair (2 Hinges)
